en.title: Seeding Rules and Automatic Byes
en.excerpt: Understanding World Archery seeding placement, bracket symmetry, and automated Bye advancements.
en.content:
Seeding Symmetry & Bracket Balance

To ensure competitive balance, World Archery rules position top qualifiers on opposing sides of the bracket tree. Rank 1 is placed at the top of the upper bracket, while Rank 2 is placed at the bottom of the lower bracket, ensuring they cannot meet until the Gold Medal Final.

Automatic Bye Allocation Rules

When the number of qualified archers is less than the bracket capacity (e.g., 12 archers in a 16-archer bracket):

  • The top 4 seeded archers (Ranks 1, 2, 3, and 4) receive automatic Byes.
  • Athletes with a Bye skip the 1/8 Round and automatically advance to the Quarterfinals.

Handling Walkovers & Withdrawals

If an athlete withdraws before match call, the scorekeeper records a Walkover (Win by Forfeit), advancing the remaining competitor into the next round.

Team Elimination Seeding

Team brackets follow identical seeding rules based on combined team qualification rankings.
